# Azure Kusto — KQL Analytics on Data Explorer

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's guide to querying and managing Azure Data Explorer (Kusto/ADX): discover clusters and databases, explore table schemas, then run KQL queries with ready-made patterns — basic retrieval, aggregations with `summarize`, time-series analysis with `bin()`, joins for root-cause correlation — plus best practices (filter early, always bound time ranges), MCP tools and an Azure CLI fallback for when MCP is unavailable. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: broad queries over billions of rows consume cluster capacity and can time out — always filter by time range and limit result sets; you need at least the Viewer role on the database. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
